node.title: Re^4: Reset meaning of empty pattern?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
On the other hand, does it really matter?

It does to me, since I inspect the results of the regex, including [doc://@+] to see how many capture groups there were.

$ perl -wMstrict -le '""=~// or die; print for @+' 0 $ perl -wMstrict -le '""=~/(?:)/ or die; ""=~// or die; print for @+' 0 $ perl -wMstrict -le '""=~/()/ or die; ""=~// or die; print for @+' 0 0

Updated examples.
